recommendedTextbook.title: Comprehensive Data Processing for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Adedapo & E. O. Babatunde
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Advanced Spreadsheet Modeling: Logical and Lookup Functions
subtopics: Nested logical functions: IF, AND, OR, NOT statements in student grade computation
Lookup and reference functions: VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX and MATCH
Data validation rules, cell protection, and conditional formatting rules
objectives: Write a nested IF formula that assigns letter grades (A1 to F9) based on numeric scores
Use VLOOKUP to retrieve student details from a master enrollment sheet
Apply conditional formatting to highlight students requiring remedial intervention

subtopics: Guided transmission media: Twisted pair (UTP/STP), coaxial cable, fiber optic cables
Unguided transmission media: Radio waves, microwaves, infrared, satellite communications
Network standards: IEEE 802.11 (Wi-Fi), 4G LTE, 5G cellular broadband
objectives: Compare bandwidth and attenuation in copper twisted pair vs fiber optic glass cables
Explain the role of geostationary satellites (NigComSat-1R) in rural internet connectivity
Select appropriate networking cabling for a 50-workstation school computer lab

topics.topic: Internet Architecture, Cloud Computing and SaaS
subtopics: Cloud computing deployment models: Public, private, hybrid, and community clouds
Cloud service models: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), Software as a Service (SaaS)
objectives: Diagram client-server request and response handshakes over HTTP
Differentiate SaaS solutions (Google Workspace, Office 365) from local desktop software
Evaluate data sovereignty and security risks when hosting institutional records in the cloud

subtopics: Concept of database anomalies: Insertion, update, and deletion anomalies in unnormalized data
First Normal Form (1NF): Eliminating repeating groups and ensuring atomic values
Second Normal Form (2NF) and Third Normal Form (3NF): Eliminating partial and transitive functional dependencies
objectives: Identify insertion and update anomalies in flat unnormalized tables
Decompose an unnormalized school register table into 1NF, 2NF, and 3NF
Construct an Entity-Relationship Diagram (ERD) with primary and foreign key constraints
